=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh
  Location: lines ~355-365, the metadata artifact write path
  Issue: When `_linked_metadata_collection_status` is not "resolved", the metadata file is written as `[{"_collection_status":"unresolved"}]`. This is the same sentinel used for "no linked issues found" and "GraphQL/fallback failed". Operators triaging a fail-closed review commit cannot distinguish "PR has no linked issues" from "PR has >50 linked issues and page was truncated" from "GraphQL returned errors".
  Suggested minimal fix: When `_linked_primary_truncated` is true, write `[{"_collection_status":"unresolved","_truncated":true,"_reason":"page_exceeded_50"}]` instead. The downstream `parse_linked_issue_metadata` already rejects any row with `_collection_status`, so behavior is unchanged; only diagnostics improve. ~3 lines.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
